translations.fr: Mon cœur, quand est-ce que tu viens ? Que Dieu te bénisse, mon fils.
translations.es: Mi corazón, ¿cuándo vienes? Que Dios te bendiga, mi hijo.
translations.it: Mio cuore, quando vieni? Che Dio ti benedica, mio figlio.
translations.en: My heart, when are you coming? May God bless you, my child.

cultural_notes.meaning: A term of endearment for a very beloved person.
A traditional blessing meaning 'May God be pleased with you'.

translations.fr: Que Dieu te garde pour moi, ma chérie.
translations.es: Que Dios te guarde para mí, mi hija.
translations.it: Che Dio ti tenga per me, mia figlia.
translations.en: May God keep you for me, my daughter.

cultural_notes.meaning: A common term of endearment used for a granddaughter or daughter.
A standard prayer for protection and preservation.

translations.fr: Comment ça va ? As-tu bien mangé ? Ne reste pas tard le soir, tu as besoin de repos.
translations.es: ¿Cómo estás? ¿Has comido bien? No te quedes despierto hasta tarde, duérmete temprano.
translations.it: Come stai? Hai mangiato bene? Non restare sveglio troppo, vai a dormire presto.
translations.en: How are you doing? Did you eat well? Don't stay up too late, you need your rest.

cultural_notes.meaning: How are you? / Are you doing okay? (This is the standard way Moroccans greet each other).

translations.fr: Je t'ai manqué beaucoup, ma chérie. La maison est vide sans toi.
translations.es: Te he echado de menos mucho, mi vida. La casa está vacía sin ti.
translations.it: Ti sei molto mancata, tesoro. La casa è vuota senza di te.
translations.en: I missed you so much, sweetie. The house feels empty without you.

cultural_notes.literal: The house is empty without you.
cultural_notes.meaning: A common expression to express loneliness and the feeling that the home lacks warmth or life when the family member is absent.

translations.fr: Que Dieu te protège et te bénisse dans tes études, ma chérie.
translations.es: Que Dios te guarde a salvo y te dé éxito en tus estudios, mi cielo.
translations.it: Che Dio ti protegga e ti dia successo nei tuoi studi, tesoro.
translations.en: May God keep you safe and help you succeed in your studies, my dear.

cultural_notes.meaning: A standard protective blessing wishing safety and health.

translations.fr: Il fait très froid aujourd'hui, merci Dieu.
translations.es: Hace mucho frío hoy, gracias a Dios.
translations.it: Fa molto freddo oggi, grazie a Dio.
translations.en: It's very cold today, thank God.

translations.fr: Mon petit, patience, patience... comme on dit, le miel se gagne avec patience.
translations.es: Mi vida, la paciencia es clave. Para tener miel, hay que esperar a la colmena.
translations.it: Tesoro, la pazienza è tutto. Per avere il miele bisogna aspettare l'alveare.
translations.en: My love, patience is key. As the saying goes, whoever wants honey must wait for the hive.

cultural_notes.expression: lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el
cultural_notes.literal: Whoever wants honey must wait for the bee's hive
cultural_notes.meaning: Good things take time and patience; you have to work for what you want.

translations.fr: Que tu sois grand comme un palmier, mon cœur, mais tu n'as pas encore mûri !
translations.es: Que seas alto como una palmera, mi amor, pero todavía no has madurado.
translations.it: Che tu sia alto come una palma, mio tesoro, ma ancora non sei maturo!
translations.en: May you be tall like a palm tree, my darling, but you still don't know how to mature!

cultural_notes.meaning: Tall, strong, or enduring (often used to describe height).
To mature, to become sensible or ready for adulthood.

translations.en: Oh my darling, you are my everything in this life.
translations.fr: Ma chérie, tu es mon tout dans cette vie.
translations.es: Mi cielo, eres mi todo en esta vida.
translations.it: Tesoro mio, sei il mio tutto in questo mondo.

cultural_notes.meaning: A term of endearment meaning 'Oh my dear' or 'Oh my darling'.
